sentences.vi: Đừng chỉ dùng I think: From my perspective, It seems to me that, I largely agree that. Nhận định chừng mực: can, may, tend to. the number of + N số nhiều → số ít; a number of → số nhiều.
sentences.exampleEn: From my perspective, visitor numbers should be limited at fragile sites. The number of tourists tends to rise in summer.

ideas.vi: Tự lập ý trước, bấm "Cần gợi ý" khi bí. Xếp cụm vào Advantages, Disadvantages hoặc Condition. Lập trường tốt nêu điều kiện (ai quyết định, giới hạn bao nhiêu).
ideas.exampleEn: income for local families → Advantages; rising rents → Disadvantages; residents involved in decisions → Condition

write.prompt: Some people believe that villages which become popular with tourists should limit the number of visitors. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
write.taskVi: essay 200–250 từ trong 40 phút, không có câu mở đầu gợi ý.
mustUse: thesis nêu mức đồng ý kèm điều kiện hoặc lý do
một cụm nêu quan điểm khác I think, không nhắc lại lập trường nhiều lần
write.modelAfterSubmit:
As travel becomes cheaper, many small villages that were once quiet now receive thousands of visitors at weekends. I largely agree that such villages should limit visitor numbers, provided that the limits are set together with local residents.

Admittedly, tourism brings real benefits to rural communities. Homestays and craft stalls allow families to earn money without leaving their village, and some of this income is used to repair old temples and roads. Tourism also gives young people a reason to stay in their village instead of moving to the city for work. A complete ban on visitors would therefore hurt the very people it is meant to protect.

However, it seems clear that too many visitors can destroy what makes a village special. When tour buses park on rice fields and rubbish piles up beside the streams, the landscape that attracts tourists begins to disappear. Rents also tend to rise as outsiders open bars and hotels, which can push young residents away. A daily limit, especially during holidays, would keep the number of visitors within what the village can handle.

In conclusion, tourism should not be stopped, but it should be controlled. As long as residents have a voice in deciding the limits, popular villages can enjoy the income from tourism without losing their way of life.

selfCheck.vi: Thesis trả lời "to what extent" và nêu điều kiện hoặc lý do?

Đoạn thừa nhận (Admittedly…) nối rõ sang đoạn trả lời (However…)?
Cụm nêu quan điểm đa dạng và đúng (From my perspective, It seems to me that, I largely agree)?
the number of + danh từ số nhiều; a number of khi nói "nhiều"?
